en: A vintage, ornately framed advertising postcard featuring a color illustration of a young woman in traditional Spanish attire. She wears a lace mantilla over her dark hair adorned with red flowers, pearl necklaces, and a green dress. The portrait is set in an oval frame with gold decorative embossing and a bow motif at the top, all on a cream background. At the bottom, in red capital letters, appears the brand and city name.
